verdict.rationale: Cekura is a SaaS platform that ships a CLI, SDK, and MCP server, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents a way to disable telemetry or usage tracking in the platform, CLI, SDK, or MCP tooling. PII redaction and metric sampling deal with customer call data and evaluation cost, not product telemetry, so they don't count here.
